label: Backtested on REAL historical prices (2017–2026). Trades are hypothetical — the strategy is applied retroactively to real history to measure what it would have returned. Validating evidence, not live results.
method: Real historical data throughout. No look-ahead: signals use only data available at each point in time. Real 10bps transaction costs charged on every trade. Chronological in-sample (65%) / out-of-sample (35%) split so recent years are tested on data the model never saw. Equities benchmarked against an equal-weight basket of the SAME universe, so any outperformance reflects selection skill, not survivorship.

strategies.name: Equity momentum (position, top 20%, monthly + vol-target 15%)
strategies.note: Vol-targeting cut drawdown from -31% to -19% while improving risk-adjusted return. Vol target is a tunable risk dial. Research round 4: tight stops cut the average trade by about two-thirds, so the book uses a wide 15% trailing stop instead.

strategies.name: Equity momentum (position, top 20%, monthly, no risk overlay)
strategies.note: Beats equal-weight-same-universe (Sharpe 0.87). Return scales smoothly with rank concentration — signature of a real signal.

strategies.name: Short-term momentum continuation (swing, weekly)
strategies.status: RETIRED Oct 2026 - did not hold up live
strategies.note: Backtested as viable, but live tracking from July to October 2026 showed +0.05% per signal before costs and it trailed the S&P 500. No new swing signals are issued.

strategies.name: Crypto vol-targeted sleeve
strategies.note: Vol-targeting cut drawdown from -87% to -59% and improved out-of-sample return. Still very high risk. No selection edge was found in crypto.

strategies.name: Bitcoin trend filter (hold above the 150-day average, else cash)
strategies.status: PASSED a pre-set bar - paper trading in a 10% sleeve
strategies.note: 2015 to 2026, 25 bps per trade. Holding Bitcoin: 66% a year, Sharpe 1.11, worst drop -83%. The edge is smaller crashes, not more return: since mid-2022 it made 35% a year against 40% for holding, with a worst drop of -28% against -53%. Three of 14 Bitcoin rules passed, so part of this may be luck. Past Bitcoin returns are unlikely to repeat.
